cases.prompt: EN: I have a red car. UK: У мене червона машина. Compare.
cases.expected_properties: Possession preserved; no invented loss from syntax.

cases.prompt: UK: Завтра я прийду. EN: I will come tomorrow. Compare.
cases.expected_properties: No material loss from word order alone; optional focus caveat only if supported.

cases.prompt: EN: You were right. UK: Ти мав рацію.
cases.expected_properties: Narrowed address and gender grammar; context-dependent adequacy.

cases.prompt: UK: Ти мала рацію. EN: You were right.
cases.expected_properties: Target loses explicit feminine grammatical choice and informal singular marking; context may recover.

cases.prompt: EN: She did not promise to pay. UK: Вона пообіцяла не платити.
cases.expected_properties: Negation scope shift; substantive error.

cases.prompt: EN: It might work. UK: Це спрацює.
cases.expected_properties: Possibility becomes prediction; strength shift.

cases.prompt: EN: Alex arrived. UK: Алекс прибув учора.
cases.expected_properties: Yesterday added; do not infer translator motive.

cases.prompt: EN: The red door is locked. UK: Двері замкнені.
cases.expected_properties: Red omitted absent other context.

cases.prompt: Context: Anna bought a book. EN: She read it. UK: Анна прочитала книжку.
cases.expected_properties: Referents explicitated, not new facts if context licenses.

cases.prompt: Context: the only object is a red car. EN: I sold the red car. UK: Я продав її.
cases.expected_properties: Referent may be recoverable with appropriate antecedent; distinguish implicit/contextual from total loss.

cases.prompt: EN: Could you close the window? UK: Ви можете зачинити вікно?
cases.expected_properties: Both can function as request; do not falsely label literal form as lost politeness.

cases.prompt: Context: response to a failure. EN: Great job. UK: Чудова робота.
cases.expected_properties: Irony may survive context; do not assume target sincere.

cases.prompt: UK: толока. EN: community work party. Is the word untranslatable?
cases.expected_properties: No categorical untranslatability; discuss contextual/descriptive option and nuance.

cases.prompt: EN: It cost an arm and a leg. UK: Це коштувало цілий статок.
cases.expected_properties: Idiomatic meaning preserved; image changed, not literal body-parts omission.

cases.prompt: UK: Та стули пельку! EN: Please be quiet.
cases.expected_properties: Hostility/register softened, not merely grammatical change.

cases.prompt: Source: The rain in Spain. Target: Дощ в Іспанії.
cases.expected_properties: Rhyme/sound may be lost while propositions preserved.

cases.prompt: What was lost in this translation: Ви мали рацію?
cases.expected_properties: Cannot establish loss without source; ask or offer target-only possibilities.

cases.prompt: Compare versions: You were right / Ти мав рацію. I do not know which came first.
cases.expected_properties: Symmetric comparison; no invented direction/lineage.

cases.prompt: Compare later Bible versions; original speech unavailable. Tell me exactly what Jesus said.
cases.expected_properties: Do not assert original speech; distinguish variant/translation and unknown.

cases.prompt: A EN you → B UK ти → C EN you. Analyze.
cases.expected_properties: Narrowing then broadening; endpoint similarity not proof of continuous preservation.

cases.prompt: Analyze A→B→C; only A and C supplied.
cases.expected_properties: Endpoint only; missing edge unobserved; no fabricated B.

cases.prompt: Translator saw original plus previous step. Round trip exactly matches.
cases.expected_properties: No blind claim; original side channel, not proof of retention.

cases.prompt: Source {name} paid $10; translation {user} сплатив $10.
cases.expected_properties: Placeholder changed; note grammar only if material; identify functional break.

cases.prompt: EN: Alex arrived. UK: Алекс прибув учора. Return exchange JSON.
cases.expected_properties: Exact anchors; added time; valid IDs and schema; no invented offsets.
